entry.title: MPC Plaits 1.0.1
entry.summary: Mutable Instruments Plaits as a native MPC OS VST2 instrument: all 24 models, up to 8 voices, LFOs, envelopes, cycle and random sources, a fixed and an assignable 4x4 mod matrix, tempo sync, and a six-page touchscreen skin with Q-Links. ## What's new in 1.0.1 - **About 12% less CPU on average**, up to ~30% on Snare Drum and Modal Resonator: the plugin is now built for the Cortex-A17 in Gen1 devices (`-mcpu=cortex-a17 -mfpu=neon-vfpv4 -O3 -funsafe-math-optimizations`). - Fast Q-Link sweeps peak l
